name: seo-suite
description: Full-spectrum SEO for Claude Code: technical, on-page, content & copywriting, keywords, schema, local, international, e-commerce, media, links, migrations, AI search (AEO/GEO), analytics, competitors and strategy — with standard-library Python auditors, code-computed prioritisation, beginner and expert guides, and cost-aware use of Semrush/Ahrefs/Screaming Frog/DataForSEO.

autonomy_level.title: Autonomy level (1-4)
autonomy_level.description: 1 Analyse (default): reads only. 2 Fix in code: edits, commits and PRs on a branch. 3 Ship: also merges PRs that pass CI and submits sitemaps/IndexNow. 4 Operate: also publishing to a CMS and Search Console sitemap submission through an authorised connector. Outreach, disavows, Change of Address, DNS/CDN, GBP and Merchant Center edits and over-budget spend are always gated: each is listed for approval and carried out only once approved. See references/autonomy.md.

semrush_monthly_units.title: Semrush monthly budget (units)
semrush_monthly_units.description: Monthly budget for paid Semrush calls, in API units. 0 (default) denies paid Semrush calls; free tools and cached results still work. Counted per UTC calendar month by the credit guard.

ahrefs_monthly_units.title: Ahrefs monthly budget (units)
ahrefs_monthly_units.description: Monthly budget for paid Ahrefs calls, in API units. 0 (default) denies paid Ahrefs calls; free tools and cached results still work. Counted per UTC calendar month by the credit guard.

dataforseo_monthly_usd.title: DataForSEO monthly budget (USD)
dataforseo_monthly_usd.description: Monthly budget for paid DataForSEO calls, in US dollars. 0 (default) denies paid DataForSEO calls; free tools and cached results still work. Counted per UTC calendar month by the credit guard.

other_monthly_usd.title: Other paid SEO tools monthly budget (USD)
other_monthly_usd.description: One shared monthly budget, in US dollars, for Similarweb, SE Ranking, Keywords Everywhere, AlsoAsked, Otterly and Lumar crawls. Their per-call prices aren't in the guard's table, so each call is budgeted at the per-call threshold. 0 (default) denies their paid calls.

per_run_cap_pct.title: Per-run cap (% of monthly budget)
per_run_cap_pct.description: The most one session may spend from each monthly budget, as a percentage of it. Default 25. 0 denies paid calls.

ask_above_pct.title: Defer above (% of monthly budget per call)
ask_above_pct.description: A single call estimated above this percentage of its monthly budget is not run: the guard records it in requests.jsonl and Claude lists it in the end-of-run questions, so runs never stop to ask. Cheaper calls inside the budget run on their own. Default 5. 0 defers every paid call.

max_rows.title: Max rows per paid call
max_rows.description: Row limit the guard enforces on every paid call (Semrush display_limit, Ahrefs limit, DataForSEO limit/depth/max_crawl_pages). A missing or larger limit is lowered to this. Default 50.

cache_ttl_days.title: Cache freshness override (days)
cache_ttl_days.description: 0 (default) uses per-data-type freshness: 30 days for keyword volumes, 7 for SERPs, rankings, domain data and backlinks, 1 for site audits. Any other value applies to every cached result. Semrush results are never reused after 30 days (Semrush terms).

psi_api_key.title: PageSpeed Insights API key
psi_api_key.description: Optional Google API key for PageSpeed Insights, which raises the quota for scripts/psi.py. It is stored in the system keychain and exported to Bash as PSI_API_KEY at session start. Never paste it into chat.
